_comment: Squarespace Events collections, read through the site's own ?format=json view by mapsee_ingest_squarespace.py. `collection` is the collection page URL (the one whose ?format=json returns {upcoming:[...]}), NOT an individual event. Category is the mapsee frontend key and only a DEFAULT - derive_categories in mapsee_supabase_sync promotes work parties to volunteer, concerts to music and classes to fitness from the text. READ THE ADAPTER'S DOCSTRING BEFORE ADDING A SITE: Squarespace ships a default map pin at 40.7207559,-74.0007613 (lower Manhattan) for every event whose location was never filled in, so the adapter only trusts mapLat/mapLng when the event carries real address text, and falls back to `venue` otherwise. A site whose events mostly have no address NEEDS a `venue` block {name, address, city, region, postal_code, lat, lon} or its events are skipped as unplaceable.

sites.name: Volunteer Park Trust
sites._venue_comment: 17 of 22 upcoming events ship the Squarespace default pin with an empty address; the 5 that are filled in give 'Volunteer Park, 1247 15th Avenue East, Seattle, WA, 98112' at 47.6303122,-122.31431. Those are the site's OWN values for the park, so the fallback below is the site's data rather than a guess - and it is correct for the whole calendar, because this is a single-park conservancy: the concerts, the fitness classes, the trail runs and the work parties all happen in Volunteer Park.
